sources.title: Muon: An optimizer for hidden layers in neural networks
sources.snippet: Muon is an optimizer for the hidden layers in neural networks. It is used in the current training speed records for both NanoGPT and CIFAR-10 speedrunning. Many empirical results using Muon have already been posted, so this writeup will focus mainly on Muon's design.
